name: FilmLab
description: Ultra-realistic 35mm analog film simulation lab with RAW camera support (Sony a7 .ARW and Adobe .DNG), featuring calibrated Kodachrome 64, Portra 400, Fuji Velvia 50, CineStill 800T, Fuji Pro 400H, Ilford HP5, and Kodak Tri-X 400 presets with precision sensitometry, EXIF telemetry, grain physics, and fold-aware layouts.
